body:
Part-Of #596
Part-Of #505
Part-Of #534

This PR packages the bounded Sprint 5/6 cutover-review remediation branch without making C-SDLC v3 live authority.

Changes:
- Adds standalone locked csdlc-v3 CI selection and workflow coverage for v3 source changes.
- Consolidates csdlc-v3 execution around a single `csdlc` binary with foundation/local subcommands.
- Strengthens read-only v2 import to recompute issue-record and card digests before accepting projections.
- Adds behavioral proof for durable reopen, failed state replacement, projection repair, review authority, finish linkage, part-of delivery, and cleanup classification/removal boundaries.
- Exercises real issue canaries for Polis/Vertex issue creation plus OBS-A/#511 and OBS-B/#512 readiness.
- Adds typed GitHub PR body update/create actions needed to avoid raw `gh` during sprint remediation.
- Adds typed local C-SDLC v2 lifecycle state for #596 with all six cards and an issue-owned remediation validator.
- Hardens typed PR body update replay so a reused operation key cannot overwrite a different governed body.
- Closes the durable v3 projection crash window by persisting repair-required state until projection success is durably cleared.

Validation:
- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 596`
- `bash .csdlc/prepared/issues/596/validate-remediation-regression.sh`
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --all-targets`
- `cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate_github_actions`
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-command-tmp cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --lib`
- `bash adl/tools/test_ci_runtime_contracts.sh`
- `bash adl/tools/test_ci_path_policy.sh`
- `bash adl/tools/csdlc_obs_ready_canary.sh`
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`

Non-claims:
- Leaves issue #596 open until its typed lifecycle is bound, reviewed, published, and reconciled.
- Leaves issue #505 open; no cutover, merge, finish, or cleanup authority is claimed.
